pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth to slightly rounded vertices. Edge transitions show a soft pixel gradient between dark and light pelage. Patches in the upper neck region occupy a larger relative spatial area than those in the lower, more occluded flank region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, interconnected network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, creating a topological graph that maintains consistent pathway thickness across the visible upper torso and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background, with fine-grained serration caused by individual hair clusters.
